systems.owner: the State, financed by a loan from Exim Bank of China
systems.tiers: all regional capitals and 36 provincial capitals; completed 2022
158 platforms and e-services, 137 online; public and private administrations

systems.platform: video surveillance, a mobile network for the security forces, 800 km of fibre

systems.country_label: Projet d'accélération de la transformation digitale (PACTDIGITAL)
systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transition; IDA credit 7462-BF of USD 150 million
systems.tiers: national, 2024-2028: backbone extension, RESINA rehabilitation, white-zone coverage, data centres

note: Finance committee report of 6 June 2024 on ratifying the IDA credit for PACTDIGITAL. It describes RESINA as the State's closed network for public administration sites and admits recurring outages, but names no commune, town hall or local authority office on it, so there is no fact.
